title: Thin Vieta Reflection Groups, Apollonian–Octahedral Obstructions, Lattice Sandpile Identities, and Markov–Hurwitz Spectra: A Zero-Mathlib Six-Kernel Formalization
description: Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 formalization of 16 statements (T1a-T3e + T2f, 19 exported audited declarations, 818 declarations exhaustively checked via Lean.collectAxioms, 9 adversarial false-variant & hypothesis-necessity refutations) covering HKRS (2024) Apollonian square obstructions on three roots, octahedral mod-8 locking, direct 9x9 Z^2 and A_2 Laplacian determinants & Dhar traces, an elementary A_2 even-Laplacian parity lemma, Zhang's (2007) Markov mod-32 theorem, 5-step Markov quiver identities, and Hurwitz's (1907) n=4 admissible coefficients — verified across 6 formal kernels and 3 independent computational oracles (zero-unsafe Rust, ISO C11 ASan/UBSan + 7-law libFuzzer, Python/Hypothesis/100% mutation).
